pages.text: The $(item)Large Explore Skyseed$() — four $(item)large$() biome seeds ringed around a spare structure seed. It grows a $(bold)large$() island of whatever biome it lands over and forces a rare building onto it — with room for structures the small Explore isle can't host.
Ring four large biome seeds around any structure seed — it is spent to make one.
$(bold)Why large?$()$(br)Many buildings — especially the modded magic ones — are too big for a small isle. This seed grows the large tier so they have space. Throw it and see what rises.
